Export workflow context for AI tools

exportWorkflowContext.Rd

Collects a compact, structured summary of key workflow configuration tables. The output can be used directly by AI assistants to reduce manual prompt setup.

Usage

exportWorkflowContext(
  projectConfiguration,
  file = "workflow-context.json",
  includeNumericValues = TRUE
)

Arguments

projectConfiguration

Project configuration object.

file

Optional output path for JSON export. If `NULL`, no file is written.

includeNumericValues

If `TRUE`, include values imported via `dataClassType = "numericValues"` when available.

Value

A named list with workflow context information.

Details

Experimental: this helper is intended for early evaluation and may change in future releases.

See also
